# Descriptions
@@ 1
Target must answer a single-concept question truthfully (though he must be
able to understand the question).
@@ 2
Target falls into natural sleep. The first round is a magical sleep (the
target cannot be awakened through normal means).
@@ 3
Humanoid target believes caster is a good friend.
@@ 4
Target will take no offensive action, and he will fight only in self-defense.
@@ 5
Target is incapable of making decisions or initiating action; but he may
continue to fight current foes or in self-defense.
@@ 6
Target fears caster and attempts to flee. Fleeing usually equates to running
at maximum pace away from the caster.
@@ 7
Target will follow a single suggested act that is not completely alien to him
(e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself, etc.).
@@ 8
Target is held to 25% of normal action.
@@ 9
Causes any desired emotion. Possible emotions include hate, love, sadness,
anger, etc.
@@ 10
Target must obey the caster as specified in Suggestion.
@@ 11
[RR Mod: +20] Target falls into a coma.
@@ 12
As Charm Kind, except works on any sentient creature.
@@ 14
As Hold Kind, except any sentient being can be affected.
@@ 15
Target is given 1 task. Failure results in a penalty determined by GM (task
must be within target’s capabilities). If the target ignores the task, he will
suffer the same effects of failure.
@@ 16
[RR Mod: -20] Target is totally paralyzed (0% action).
@@ 18
Target is a blathering idiot. He may be led around but he can take no action.
@@ 20
[RR Mod: -20] Target is unconscious and unwakeable.
@@ 25
As Geas, except failure is punished by the target suffering five 'E' criticals
(choose which critical types randomly).
@@ 30
When he concentrates, caster has total control of target’s mind. After the
initial casting, the range for control is 1 mile per level of the caster.
@@ 50
As Mind Control True, except duration is permanent (until dispelled). The
caster need only concentrate to give commands. Only one target can be
controlled in this fashion at a time.
